script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/img.png" --expect 200 --raw-out "$F/img.out" \
  --check-header content-length eq 4096 --check-header etag exists --check-header last-modified exists \
  --check-header accept-ranges eq bytes --save F16.file-bytes/png
cmp "$F/img.out" "$F/ws/img.png"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/sub/docs/notes.txt" --expect 200 --check . contains 'qa-f16 notes v1' --check-header content-length eq 16
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/my%20file%20%C3%A9.txt" --expect 200 --check . contains 'qa-f16 spaced' --save F16.file-bytes/encoded-name
